name: Josh Nguyen
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I am a clinical psychologist and board-approved supervisor in Parkville, Melbourne. I work primarily with couples, LGBTQIA+ adults, neurodivergent adults, and people from multicultural backgrounds. Contributes to LGBTQ+ and multicultural mental health advisory work.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, diverse sexualities, diverse genders, couples therapy, sexual difficulties, sex worker issues, neurodivergent adults, CBT, ACT, psychodynamic

name: Robyn Ming
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Robyn has a particular interest in working with the LGBTQIA+ community, providing a safe, non-judgemental space to explore issues related to gender and sexuality, and provides gender affirmative care. Listed issues include Dissociative Identity Disorder, PTSD and gender dysphoria; approaches include Schema Therapy.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, gender affirmative care, diverse genders, diverse sexualities, Dissociative Identity Disorder, PTSD, Schema Therapy, ACT, CBT

name: Gemma Laming
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical psychologist with a special interest in providing support for the LGBTIQA+ community. Works with diverse genders, diverse sexualities, gender dysphoria, PTSD and adult survivors of sexual abuse using Schema Therapy, ACT and CBT. Also sees clients in Fitzroy North.
specialties: LGBTIQA+, diverse genders, gender dysphoria, diverse sexualities, PTSD, sexual abuse, Schema Therapy, ACT, CBT

name: Dr Mike Van Dijkhuizen
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Specialises in depression, anxiety, addiction, trauma, anger, relationships and sexuality concerns, with an identity-affirming approach for LGBTQ+ clients. Integrates ACT with CBT, schema therapy and DBT. Works by telehealth from Melbourne.
specialties: LGBTQ+, sexuality, trauma, diverse genders, gender dysphoria, schema therapy, ACT, DBT, sexual difficulties
